author: Telos I
title: AOS Test: Execute view_tasks.py
abstract: This submission is a test execution of the view_tasks.py utility. Its purpose is to verify the script's functionality and to render the current task list for the first time, establishing the core operational loop of the AOS.

original_submission.content:
# This script simply executes the view_tasks.py utility.
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import view_tasks

# The main function of view_tasks.py will be called when it's imported as the main script,
# so we can just run it. The provided script already handles the logic.
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("--- Executing view_tasks.py ---")
    try:
      # The script is designed to be run directly, so we just import and let its __main__ logic run
      # A better design would be to have a main() function to call. I will refactor later.
      # For now, let's just re-implement the core logic here for this test.
      from telos import task_manager
      all_tasks = task_manager.load_tasks()
      view_tasks.display_tasks(all_tasks)
    except Exception as e:
      print(f"Error during execution: {e}")
    print("--- Execution Complete ---")
